reviews.text:
Samsung TV app crashes when playing in 4K/1080p. After finishing an episode and selecting the next one, it starts loading and then crashes back to the iQIYI home screen or completely exits to the Samsung TV menu. I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled the app several times with no improvement.

Okay, cool. I’ll just screencast. That’s an option. I pay for the version with no ads but when I screencast, there are ads and pop ups. Pop ups in a streaming service app? That’s weird. There’s an ad every time I open the app, but again I pay for no ads. 

Also, the quality of the video goes down screencasting? That doesn’t happen on the Zeus Network app? I would think it would be the other way around. 

Screencasting also glitches and will start playing the wrong episode out of no where? Like my phone says episode 186 is playing but the tv is playing episode 183. And it makes it super complicated to get onto the right episode. 

Moving past all that, the app itself isn’t user friendly. It’s not super complex to navigate the app, but it’s not as organized as something like Crunchyroll. The way the genres are split up and categorized is dumb. Not every show has the time schedule attached but some do. Like that just seems lazy. 

A few of the shows have poorly translated subtitles. Some are so bad that the English makes my brain hurt. So I feel like it’s a rip off even though it’s pretty cheap.

reviews.title: Way to much AI
reviews.text:
I used to adore this app so much, I loved the shows and I loved the variety. I started seeing a bit of AI start to trickle in and at first I thought it was just a show but now I’m seeing it more and more. I’ve come to realize that they announced that they are going to push AI generated content to be most of their content within the next five years, I cannot support this. It kills our planet and there’s no soul behind a show created by AI. I feel like I must pull the plug now before all I see is stuff from a bot. If they stop using AI to generate shows and content, then I’d come back. But so long as these corporations decide to push this as it kills the land at my home, my money will go elsewhere.

Also, for those who become premium VIP members as I was, their song subtitles will cover their faces throughout very important scenes just FYI. You’ll still occasionally get a three second start to an ad, and even though you’ve been a VIP member for three years, it will still tell you you should be a VIP member!

reviews.title: Ads everywhere
reviews.text:
This app has way too many ads. Even after subscribing to premium there are still a ton of ads. Ads when you pause, pop-up ads while you’re watching, banner ads just browsing the shows. Just a terrible experience having to constantly tap off these ads.
Which is a shame because the shows are enjoyable. Though even those have issue with subtitles as when there is a song playing in the background, the lyrics are plastered in the middle of the screen just blocking everything. And these songs usually play in important scenes and the lyrics subtitles just ruin it.

reviews.title: Annoying ads even when paying for VIP
reviews.text:
Ok, don’t get me wrong, the selection of shows and the layout reminds me so much of Viki so that’s not a bad start.  What you might find annoying is the fact that although you paid for VIP premium and the fact that it states skippable ads, you still do in fact get ads. 

Not commercial ads, but ads upon launching the app that tells you the finale is coming.  Who cares?   Mind you, you can’t skip the ad until it counts down. 

You’ll get ads to buy VIP unlock coins. Seriously?  I paid for premium and you’re bugging me to buy coins? 

You’ll get ads to download the IQIYI tv app practically all the time.  Pop-up ads! 

Seriously. I already paid for VIP premium. I just want a video player that will play my shows without bothering me all the time about stuff I don’t care about.   It cheapens the app, the whole user experience, and makes it seem like I’m just watching shows off some ad-infested mobile website.

reviews.title: VIP subscription
reviews.text: As their subscription services are on the pricier side, I had planned in advance to cancel after my first month with them. But I had issues with cancelling the subscription, even though I tried doing so several days before the renewal as well as on the day of renewal. I thought I had cancelled successfully until the day of renewal, when I saw I was charged again. I immediately contacted their customer service in hopes of getting a refund since this is my first subscription to their membership, ever. However they are only reachable by email and so I emailed them. On each response in our email thread, they were unflexible and simply explained that I “should cancel” if I didn’t want VIP anymore, a concept I am more than familiar with as I simply did not know HOW to cancel.

reviews.title: Frustrated

Then you have to get out of that episode, run a different episode, then go back to the one you on, and sometimes, you have to do that a couple of times. How not enjoyable is that!!  I wrote to them and got absolutely no help at all.  I’m going to try Vicki.  I hate leaving because they have a great selection, but I just can’t deal with this huge flaw and no customer support, none.
